name: rosetta-writer-monad
code:
use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Math.sqrt

use Writer[T] = (value: T, log: string)

unit[T](value: T, note: string) -> Writer[T] =>
    (value = value, log = "  {note,-17}: {value}\n")

>>=[T, U](writer: Writer[T], f: (T) -> Writer[U]) -> Writer[U] =>
    (let next = f(writer.value)
     (value = next.value, log = "{writer.log}{next.log}"))

root(value: int) -> Writer[double] =>
    unit(sqrt(cast(value)), "Took square root")

add_one(value: double) -> Writer[double] =>
    unit(value + 1.0D, "Added one")

half(value: double) -> Writer[double] =>
    unit(value / 2.0D, "Divided by two")

let golden = unit(5, "Initial value") >>= root >>= add_one >>= half

write_line("The golden ratio is {golden.value}")
write_line()
write_line("This was derived as follows:")
write(golden.log)
